w: At 11.05 am Swamishri performed the maha-puja as part of the 'Bhumi-Pujan' ceremony for the new mandir site. More than 300 devotees participated in the maha-puja.
Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees during the evening assembly.

8 August 2000: (V.S. 2056, Shravan Sud 9, Tuesday, Jackson (Mississippi) Swamishri performed the murti-pratistha of the marble murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam, Shri Radha Krishna Dev, Shri Hari Krishna Maharaj, Shri Ganapatiji & Guru Parampara (canvas). In the evening assembly the Mayor of Jackson city, Mr.Harvey Johnson Jr., presented Swamishri with the 'Key to the City'. After Swamishri's blessings, the devotees honored Lord Harikrishna Maharaj.

From Akshardham A youth asked Swamishri, "Bapa! Where do you really come from?" Swamishri replied , "We don't come from homes like you do. God has sent us (himself) from Akshardham. You have all come to attain moksha and we have come to do this work (to redeem).

Seva - the Way to Akshardham During his visit around the mandir, Swamishri arrived at the medical department. Dr. Harshad requested Swamishri to sit on his chair. Then he gave his stethoscope to Swamishri and told him, "Bapa. We check patients whereas you are the Doctor of doctors so today I ask you to check me." When Swamishri placed the stethoscope on his heart Dr. Harshad asked, " Will it go to Akshardham?" Swamishri replied in a doctor's confident style, "Yes, it is really eligible to go to Akshardham." "Then Bapa, What about us?" the devotees present chorused. Swamishri, raising his hand, replied in a divine mood, "Everyone will go to Akshardham! There is Akshardham for all those who do 'Seva'".

Swamishri visited the historic place where Bishop Heber had met Shriji Maharaj. He also saw the under construction of 'Swaminarayan Smruti Mandir' by BAPS nearby, that will become a memorial to the historic meeting and the life and message of Shriji Maharaj.
In the evening Swamishri initiated (vratman) 300 children into the Satsang-fold.
